meta.title: Stock ticker
meta.description: Adds a compact quote strip under the composer for a configurable list of A-share, Hong Kong and US symbols: name, code, price, change percent, a limit-up/limit-down marker and a mini daily K-line. Clicking a card opens a detail panel with 分时 (intraday), 5-minute, daily, weekly and monthly charts, open/high/low/previous close, turnover value, turnover rate, volume ratio, amplitude, P/E, P/B and market cap for A-shares, plus the five-level order book and bid/ask ratio. Symbols can be typed into the strip's settings form and are saved to this plugin's config in the profile; they also work when edited directly in cordis.patch.yml. Quotes come from Tencent's public endpoints, with Sina used automatically when Tencent answers nothing; intraday and K-line data come from Tencent. The strip refreshes on the cadence the Host recommends for the current session (about 15 s while a market is open, at least 30 s during a break and at least 60 s after the close), pauses while the tab is hidden or the symbol form is open, and stretches the interval up to 2 minutes while requests keep failing. Quotes are cached for 3 s, K-lines for 5 minutes and intraday lines for 20 s (5 minutes when closed). The plugin only displays public market data, places no orders and reads no session or agent data. Turning it off removes the strip.
